423ed336-0645-8163-a8dd-e12275fc660d.markdown: Status: Draft. Owner: Sample Author. Target release . ## 1. Problem Shoppers abandon the cart when the total is above 120 EUR. We want to give loyalty points at checkout so that a returning shopper sees value before paying. See [Baymard abandonment study](https://baymard.com/lists/cart-abandonment-rate). ## 2. Goals 1. Raise checkout conversion for returning shoppers by 3%. 2. Show earned points before payment. 3. Keep checkout latency p95 under 800 ms. ## 3. Non-goals - Points redemption (phase 2). - Partner points (airlines, hotels). ## 4. Requirements | ID | Requirement | Priority | | --- | --- | --- | | FR-1 | The system shows earned points on the checkout summary | Must | | FR-2 | The system credits points after the payment is captured | Must | | FR-3 | The shopper can see a points history page | Should | | NFR-1 | Points service answers in 150 ms p95 | Must | ### 4.1 Points formula Points are one per full euro, doubled for Gold tier: $$ points = \lfloor total \rfloor \times (tier = Gold ? 2 : 1) $$ ### 4.2 Acceptance checklist - [x] Formula agreed with Finance - [ ] Tier source agreed with CRM team - [ ] Fraud rule for refunded orders Open questions - Do refunds remove points immediately or after 30 days? - Does a guest checkout earn points? Legacy note (plain toggle) The old program used stamps. ## 5. API sketch ```py def earned_points(total_eur: float, tier: str) -> int: base = int(total_eur) return base * 2 if tier == "Gold" else base ``` > Quote: "Give value before the shopper pays." - Head of Product Option A - compute in cart service - Fast - Couples cart to loyalty Option B - loyalty service call - Clean boundary - Extra network hop --- Risk: the CRM tier field is not reliable for 4% of accounts. Inline colored text, struck text, underlined, inline code points_v2, inline math $x^2$. 423ed336-0645-816a-aff4-ffe7862445e1.markdown: Context The points ledger must be auditable. Finance asks for a full history of every credit and debit. Decision We store points as an append-only event stream in PostgreSQL. A projection keeps the balance. Consequences - Rebuild of a projection takes up to 10 minutes. - Every consumer must be idempotent. Glossary: Ledger - the append-only list of point events. Projection - the current balance per shopper. Decided on by Sample Author. $$ balance = \sum_{e \in events} e.delta $$
